title: The Ventyra R1 is a DIY off-grid wind turbine that works with solar — and it's smashed its Kickstarter goal by 90x thanks to $179 starting price
summary: While this isn't quite the first portable wind turbine we've ever seen, they're a lot rarer than portable solar panels and chargers, and the Ventyra R1 seems to get a lot right — as far as we can tell without testing it.
